stories.title: Jio IPO priced at Rs 1,065‑1,119, opens Oct 21, closes Oct 23; GMP suggests Rs 1,364 listing price
stories.summary: Reliance Jio’s initial public offering will open on October 21 and close on October 23, with a price band of Rs 1,065 to Rs 1,119 per share. The grey‑market premium at the top of the band points to an indicative listing price of about Rs 1,364 per share.
stories.why: The pricing and GMP give investors an early gauge of market appetite and potential listing valuation.
stories.change: New high-signal event entered the brief.

stories.title: Tenstorrent raises $1.5 billion, valuation hits $6.2 billion
stories.summary: Tenstorrent, a chip startup focused on AI inference, completed a $1.5 billion financing round that values the company at $6.2 billion, more than double its late‑2024 valuation of $2.6 billion. The round was led by Trace Capital and Innovation X, with participation from Cadence Ventures, Eclipse, Fidelity, SanDisk and T. Rowe Price. CEO Jim Keller said the proceeds will be used to scale chips for open‑weight AI models and video‑generation after Galaxy servers demonstrated the ability to run DeepSeek models.
stories.why: The funding enables Tenstorrent to expand production of specialized AI inference chips, increasing competition in the open‑weight model market.

stories.title: India‑NZ free‑trade pact in force, over half of NZ exports tariff‑free
stories.summary: The free‑trade agreement between India and New Zealand has come into force, removing tariffs on more than half of New Zealand’s exports to India. Those exports previously faced duties that are now eliminated under the pact. New Zealand also signalled interest in pursuing comparable trade agreements with Brazil and Canada.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.

stories.title: RBI injects Rs 1 lakh crore as liquidity tightens before festive season
stories.summary: On Monday, the RBI announced a Rs 1-lakh-crore variable rate repo (VRR) auction for the first time since late July after the weighted average call rate (WACR) at 5.67% on Monday, or 17 basis points higher than the repo rate of 5.50%. The central bank will conduct another VRR for Rs 50,000 crore on Wednesday.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.title: RBI tightens review of $1 billion‑plus overseas investments by Indian firms
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has instructed banks to gather and submit detailed information on overseas direct investments exceeding $1 billion made by Indian companies. A prescribed checklist requires banks to conduct due‑diligence on the rationale for each investment before reporting it to the RBI. The measure is aimed at preventing losses for the firms and protecting the Indian economy.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.summary: A little over a month ago, Anthropic and AI infrastructure provider Nscale announced a $45 billion compute deal . Bloomberg reports that the two companies are said to be on the verge of announcing yet another $45 billion compute deal, citing people familiar with the matter.

stories.title: Houthi missile strike on Yemen camp kills 50 security recruits, local authorities say
stories.summary: Yemen's government said the missile strike killed recruits to its internal security forces (file photo) More than 50 security personnel have been killed and 200 injured in a Houthi missile strike on a camp in Yemen's central province of Shabwa, local authorities say. A spokesman for the Saudi-backed Yemeni armed forces said the Iran-backed group launched three ballistic missiles at al-Alam camp near Ataq city, which was being used as a training centre for recruits to the security forces and police.
stories.why: This matters because it could affect economic conditions, trade, technology, public systems or international decisions.
